metadata.title: When you get 1 kill and act like you just hacked the game in VALORANT
metadata.description:
Wait, did that really happen? My brain definitely wasn’t in the game.
Watch me fake confidence after a total fluke kill.
VALORANT’s weird logic saves me again.
Click if your aim ever ghosted but luck showed up!

Hit play if your luck once made you look like a pro!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckygamer #funnyclips #shorts
